┌─ Help: Moving, doors, people ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Moving and doors                                                                                                                         │
│   Arrows, W A S D   tap for one 3 m step; hold to walk that way, let go to stop                                                          │
│   Esc               stop a walk begun by an Option-click                                                                                 │
│   E, Enter          go through the nearest door (stand at it)                                                                            │
│   M                 the large map: Option-click a spot to walk there                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│   A terminal that reports key releases (Kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm, recent iTerm2) stops you the moment you let go. Any other steps once on │
│   a single press and walks while the key repeats, stopping about a tenth of a second after the repeats stop. Two keys held at once walk  │
│   a diagonal where your terminal reports them.                                                                                           │
│   Your own mark runs ahead of the server's word so a key shows at once, and it never walks through a wall; the server settles where you  │
│   are. The status line says how fast you go on the ground you stand on.                                                                  │
│   A door (D) leads to the next zone or to an instance. A zone line (the east gate, say) takes you across; E at the far side brings you   │
│   back. A door that cannot be used says why in the line under the log, and Nearby marks it (shut).                                       │
│   Nearby lists what is around you by name and distance: people, doors and places, and the town's fixed people even before you have seen  │
│   them.                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Talking, trainers and contracts                                                                                                          │
│   G                 talk to the nearest person; their options open a trader, a trainer or a board                                        │
│   N                 traders in view: buy, sell, learn an ability, set your bind point, bank                                              │
│   K                 the contracts you hold                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│   A contract board offers hunts, gathering and scouting. Hand a finished one in at any contract board in town, not only the one that     │
│   posted it. Nothing here is required and nothing waits for you: play in any order.                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Messages from the server                                                                                                                 │
│   A server announcement shows in bold at the top of the screen for a few seconds, or until your next key, and stays in Events as a line  │
│   that begins "Server:".                                                                                                                 │
│   A game master's own words reach you the same way: a mute shows in Events, in red, and again when you try to speak; a suspension, a ban │
│   or a kick shows at the top while the client is off the server.                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ When something is refused                                                                                                                │
│   The server's reason shows in red with a ! in Events, and the status line goes red with it until your next key. Pressing E at a shut    │
│   door still asks the server; the reason is its answer.                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                          │
